Description.SourceString: Snakes have a terrible deal in life. They must crawl along the floor, in the filth everyone else steps over. They suffer hate, fear and aggression from everyone who sees them and worst of all, if they bite their tongue, they're doomed. This snakeskin leather is gathered exclusively from the latter snakes, those who chomped down inefficiently and became their own undoing. This makes the leather both ethical and comparatively easy to gather. Waste not, want not, after all.
